text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 27, 2024) for 2675 Bloor Street West.

The Property Standards Committee - Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 27, 2024) for 2675 Bloor Street West, Folder Number 24 202663 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 29, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
